name: Watchgoose APIs
description: The current Management API v3 for checks and integrations, plus the capability-URL Pinging API used by monitored jobs. Authenticated Management operations use X-Api-Key. Management POST requests may alternatively carry api_key in the JSON body; OpenAPI security requirements cannot represent body credentials, so ApiKeyAuth models the preferred header form.
